comment: sys/unix/unixmain.c main() (255-262) prints 'Restoring save file...' with pline() before dorecover() when no configuration raw_printf() ran. In normal play the restore asks nothing, so the first key after the welcome-back line is ^P, and msg_window:full lists the whole history: the first segment's messages, which win/tty/topl.c tty_putmsghistory() restores first, then 'Restoring save file...', then the welcome back.
